findings.label: Incomplete ownership validation for storage files
findings.description: The worker validates database record ownership but doesn't verify the storage file path belongs to the same user, allowing potential access to other users' files.

findings.label: Insecure file path resolution
findings.description: Path traversal check uses relative_to() without ensuring the base directory is absolute and resolved first, which could be bypassed with crafted paths.

findings.label: Runtime errors not categorized
findings.description: Missing optional dependencies (pypdf, python-docx) raise RuntimeError that propagates as a generic processing error instead of being handled explicitly.

findings.label: Queue re-enqueue loses retry context
findings.description: When jobs are re-enqueued on failure, the retry_count and delay metadata are added to a new payload rather than preserving the original job's context, potentially causing incorrect retry logic.

findings.label: Database connection never initialized in connect()
findings.description: The connect() method calls init_db() but never assigns a connection to self._db. Every call to _get_db() creates a new database connection instead of reusing one.

findings.label: Unreachable code in count_all() and count_for_user()
findings.description: count_all() is missing a return statement entirely. count_for_user() has two return statements with the second being unreachable.

findings.label: Missing job type validation
findings.description: The run() method processes any job without checking job["type"] == "index_document".

findings.label: Path traversal vulnerability in _sanitize_path
findings.description: _sanitize_path uses Path(storage_path).name which strips the directory path. Only the filename is used, losing the user-specific subdirectory.

findings.label: Missing is_deleted column in database schema
findings.description: count_for_user() queries documents.is_deleted column that may not exist in schema.

findings.label: Inconsistent database commit patterns
findings.description: _update_status() commits immediately, breaking transactional consistency when called multiple times in sequence.

findings.label: Missing retry_count validation
findings.description: retry_count from job payload is used directly without validation.
